en_title: Grand Theft Auto VI Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Are Out This Week
cn_title: 《侠盗猎车手VI》限量版PS5 DualSense控制器将于本周发售
opus_summary: 索尼与Rockstar合作推出两款《GTA6》主题限定版PS5 DualSense手柄，分别为白色和黑色，每款售价84.99美元(约合人民币567元)，预定于11月19日与游戏同日发售，现已开放预购。白色版在多家零售商限量销售，黑色版则由PlayStation Direct独家销售。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 the game is almost here, and so are the PS5 controllers. Sony and Rockstar are partnering up to release two different limited-edition GTA 6-themed PS5 DualSense controllers. One is black and one is white. The designs are relatively subtle, but they both look tasteful and appealing. They cost $84.99 each and are set to release on November 19, the same day as the game. Preorders are live now ( see at Walmart ). Read on for more info.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》游戏即将推出，PS5控制器也快到了。索尼与Rockstar合作，将推出两款不同的《GTA6》主题限量版PS5 DualSense控制器。一款是黑色，另一款是白色。设计相对低调，但两款看起来都很有品位，也很吸引人。每款售价84.99美元，计划于11月19日发售，与游戏同一天。预购现已开启（可前往Walmart查看）。继续阅读以了解更多信息。

paragraphs.en: The white version of the controller is available in limited quantities at a variety of retailers. Sony says the white one “embodies Vice City at daybreak, from its white sands and pastel skies to all its laid-back glamour.”
paragraphs.cn: 白色版控制器在多家零售商处限量发售。索尼表示，白色版「体现了黎明时分的罪恶城，从白色沙滩、柔和色调的天空到其悠闲的魅力」。

paragraphs.en: If black is more your speed, you can get the black color varaiant. The black version is exclusive to PlayStation Direct . Sony says this one “captures the energy of Vice City’s iconic nightlife.”
paragraphs.cn: 如果你更喜欢黑色，可以购买黑色款。黑色版由PlayStation Direct独家发售。索尼表示，这一款「捕捉到了罪恶城标志性夜生活的活力」。

paragraphs.en: On both controllers, the inside of the grips have a “shimmering, color-shifting finish” that changes color as you turn the controllers in the light. Both feature a big but subtle “VI” on the touchpad, as well as textured, inset palm tree etchings in the grips.
paragraphs.cn: 两款控制器的握把内侧都采用了「闪烁的变色涂层」，在光线下转动控制器时会变换颜色。两款的触摸板上都有一个大而低调的「VI」，握把上还有带纹理的内嵌棕榈树蚀刻图案。

paragraphs.en: Aside from that, these are your standard DualSense controllers with all of the expected functionality: haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, a big old touch pad – the usual good stuff we all appreciate.
paragraphs.cn: 除此之外，这些都是标准的DualSense控制器，具备所有预期功能：触觉反馈、自适应扳机、一个大触摸板——这些都是我们一向喜欢的好东西。

paragraphs.en: In other news, you can preorder Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 ahead of the November 19 launch. If you do preorder, whether in physical or digital format , you’ll be able to preload it a week ahead of launch so you’re not taking up precious time downloading when you could be playing.
paragraphs.cn: 另一个消息是，你可以在11月19日发售前预购PS5版《侠盗猎车手VI》。如果预购，无论是实体版还是数字版，你都可以在发售前一周预载，这样就不必在本可以游玩的时候花费宝贵时间下载。

paragraphs.en: “Physical” copies don’t include a disk — just a download code — but they're already shipping, so you'll still have time to preload. In the meantime, you can rewatch the GTA 6 extended look as many times as you want.
paragraphs.cn: 「实体」版不包含光盘，只有一个下载码，不过它们已经开始发货，所以你仍有时间预载。在此期间，你可以随意反复观看《GTA6》的加长展示。

paragraphs.en: If you're in the market for other PS5 controllers, the Marvel's Wolverine DualSense looks pretty great as well.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你正在物色其他PS5控制器，《漫威金刚狼》DualSense看起来也相当不错。
